title: THE GUN CARD HAS A SPOT OF ITS OWN
why: His note of 2026-10-14: the gun cards on the right are causing collisions. The card shown when you pick up a gun sat at the right edge, 60 percent of the way down, which is where CONDITIONS (grown by its contracts), the run goals, the co-op kill feed and the pickup rows all end up, so on a pickup it landed on top of one or more of them. It now stands on the gear readout at the bottom right, just left of the right column, where nothing else is drawn, and it steps further left if the kill feed or a wide pickup row reaches it. The kill feed also keeps clear of the run goals now, as it did of CONDITIONS.
now: The gun card on pickup now has its own spot above the gear readout, clear of CONDITIONS, the run goals, the kill feed and the pickup rows.

edits.replacement:
var _gcm=gunCompare(C.w,C.vs), _gsp=gunCardSpot(_gcm,C.route);   // v16.xx (gcfix): its own spot, left of the right column and on the gear readout
  var _gch=gunCardDraw(_gcm,_gsp.xR,_gsp.yB,Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(GUNCARD_T-age)/0.5)),C.route);
